svg.title: yay-machine vs XState: all benchmarks
svg.desc: UI: sign-up form, form session (38 events): yay-machine 1.30M events/s, XState 162k events/s; 8.1× faster. Event stream: long-lived connection, replay 1,000-event trace: yay-machine 5.24M events/s, XState 283k events/s; 19× faster. Fleet: 1,000 live connections, 1 event to each of 1,000 instances: yay-machine 2.18M events/s, XState 192k events/s; 11× faster. Login request, login success + logout: yay-machine 271k requests/s, XState 18.9k requests/s; 14× faster. Login request, login rejected + retry: yay-machine 320k requests/s, XState 18.0k requests/s; 18× faster. Memory per live instance, started, idle (disconnected): yay-machine 1.23 KiB per instance, XState 2.69 KiB per instance; 2.2× less memory. Memory per live instance, connected (with heartbeat resource): yay-machine 1.33 KiB per instance, XState 3.94 KiB per instance; 3.0× less memory. Toggle, send TOGGLE: yay-machine 3.53M events/s, XState 164k events/s; 22× faster. Counter, INCREMENT + DECREMENT (guards pass): yay-machine 1.35M events/s, XState 254k events/s; 5.3× faster. Counter, INCREMENT beyond max (guard rejects): yay-machine 9.29M events/s, XState 828k events/s; 11× faster. Guards, 1st guard matches: yay-machine 2.08M events/s, XState 268k events/s; 7.8× faster. Guards, 3rd guard matches: yay-machine 1.79M events/s, XState 287k events/s; 6.3× faster. Guards, default (5th) matches: yay-machine 1.93M events/s, XState 236k events/s; 8.2× faster. Immediate transitions, routes via 1st branch: yay-machine 1.61M events/s, XState 91.0k events/s; 18× faster. Immediate transitions, routes via last branch: yay-machine 1.27M events/s, XState 89.3k events/s; 14× faster. Event resolution, handled by current state: yay-machine 2.00M events/s, XState 249k events/s; 8.0× faster. Event resolution, falls through to machine-level: yay-machine 2.05M events/s, XState 221k events/s; 9.3× faster. Event resolution, not handled (ignored): yay-machine 28.5M events/s, XState 670k events/s; 43× faster. State effects, entry + exit actions: yay-machine 2.01M events/s, XState 129k events/s; 16× faster. State effects, state-scoped resource + cleanup: yay-machine 1.96M events/s, XState 63.9k events/s; 31× faster. Lifecycle, define a 5-state machine: yay-machine 593k definitions/s, XState 37.4k definitions/s; 16× faster. Lifecycle, create + start + stop: yay-machine 1.18M lifecycles/s, XState 92.7k lifecycles/s; 13× faster. Lifecycle, ... with machine-scoped resource: yay-machine 1.09M lifecycles/s, XState 31.1k lifecycles/s; 35× faster. Batch of short-lived instances, batch of 10: yay-machine 870k lifecycles/s, XState 50.3k lifecycles/s; 17× faster.
